name: LEGACY-CHOICE-no-lineage-founds
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: a character who answered no lineage founded a house anyway.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-online-load-founds
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: online, a character loaded with no house founded one (the old B4 law).

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-answer-unread
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the character's own answer never read at a load.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-boot-is-a-birth
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the boot's call taken for a birth.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-answer-not-kept
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the answer never kept on the character.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-any-answer-kept
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: a result the question was not put to keeps a word.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-not-saved
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the answer dropped by the save.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-no-third-online
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: online the question keeps its two.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-third-offline
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: offline the question grows a third.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-flat-screen
old: faceText: online ? LEGACY_CHOICE_FACE : LEGACY_MODEL_FACE, faceTags: LEGACY_MODEL_TAGS, stacked: online,
new: faceText: online ? LEGACY_CHOICE_FACE : LEGACY_MODEL_FACE, faceTags: LEGACY_MODEL_TAGS, stacked: false,
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: three answers on the fixed pitch - the third off the screen.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-offline-words
old: faceText: online ? LEGACY_CHOICE_FACE : LEGACY_MODEL_FACE, faceTags: LEGACY_MODEL_TAGS, stacked: online,
new: faceText: LEGACY_MODEL_FACE, faceTags: LEGACY_MODEL_TAGS, stacked: online,
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the popup's words never its own online.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-no-third-key
old: 'char:3': 'three', Digit3: 'three', Numpad3: 'three',   // LEGACY-CHOICE: the third answer online
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: no key answers the third.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-third-key-unarmed
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the third key answers nothing.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-up-is-down
old: const n = this.options.length, step = move === 'up' ? n - 1 : 1;
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: up moves down.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-tops-unstacked
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: a stacked screen laid on the fixed pitch.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-narrow-popup
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the popup never widens for three.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-no-lineage-unsaid
old: : prov.choice?.() === NO_LINEAGE ? 'This character chose to live without a house. Make a new character to found one.'
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the tab never says the character chose no house.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-online-unsaid
old: : prov.online?.() ? 'This character has no house - online, a house is founded only when a character is made. Make a new character to found one.'
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the tab tells an online character an older one is founded at a load.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-tab-unwired
old: choice: () => playerEntity.legacyChoice ?? null,   // LEGACY-CHOICE: why a character has no house
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the tab never handed the character's answer.

name: LEGACY-CHOICE-third-tag-echoes-its-title
note: LEGACY-CHOICE: the third tile's tag said its title over again (NO LINEAGE / NO LINEAGE) instead of what its death is.

name: LEGACY-POINTER-hover-under-the-face
old: if (this._fired || this._faced) return;   // LEGACY-POINTER: the Plus face's tiles own the pointer
new: if (this._fired) return;   // LEGACY-POINTER: the Plus face's tiles own the pointer
note: LEGACY-POINTER: the hosts' window-level mousemove moved the Plus face's choice by the canvas face's rows (the field report).

name: LEGACY-POINTER-click-under-the-face
note: LEGACY-POINTER: a canvas press answered by the canvas face's rows while the Plus face was up.

name: LEGACY-POINTER-face-never-noted
note: LEGACY-POINTER: the face drawn and never noted - the canvas seam kept the pointer under it.

name: LEGACY-POINTER-face-never-cleared
note: LEGACY-POINTER: a question back on the canvas (the skin switched under it) never took the canvas pointer again.
